abstract: BACKGROUND: A direct association between radiotherapy dose, side-effects and secondary cancers has been described in patients with seminoma. A treatment planning study was performed in order to compare computed tomography-based traditional radiotherapy (CT-tRT) versus bone marrow-sparing intensity-modulated radiation therapy (BMS-IMRT) in patients with Stage I seminoma. MATERIAL AND METHODS: We optimized in 10 patients a CT-tRT and a BMS-IMRT treatment plan to deliver 20 Gy to the para-aortic nodes. CT-tRT and IMRT consisted of anteroposterior-posterioranterior parallel-opposed and seven non-opposed coplanar fields using 16 and 6-MV photon energies, respectively. Dose-Volume Histograms for clinical target volume (CTV), planning target volume (PTV) and organs at risk (OARs) were compared for both techniques using Wilcoxon matched-pair signed rank-test. RESULTS: D(mean) to CTV and PTV were similar for both techniques, even if CT-tRT showed a slightly improved target coverage in terms of PTV-D(95%) (19.7 vs. 19.5 Gy, p = 0.005) and PTV-V(95%) (100 vs. 99.7%, p = 0.011) compared to BMS-IMRT. BMS-IMRT resulted in a significant reduction (5.2 Gy, p = 0.005) in the D(mean) to the active bone marrow (ABM). The V(100%) and V(75%) of the OARs were reduced with BMS-IMRT by: ABM-V(100%) = 51.7% and ABM-V(75%) = 42.3%; bowel-V(100%) = 15.7% and bowel-V(75%) = 16.8%; stomach-V(100%) = 22% and stomach-V(75%) = 27.7%; pancreas-V(100%) = 37.1% and pancreas-V(75%) = 35.9% (p = 0.005 for all variables). CONCLUSIONS: BMS-IMRT reduces markedly the dose to the OARs compared to CT-tRT. This should translate into a reduction in acute and long-term toxicity, as well as into the risk of secondary solid and hematological cancers.
abstract_ja:
背景：セミノーマ患者では、放射線療法の線量と副作用・二次がんとの直接的な関連が報告されている。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)を用いた従来型放射線療法(CT-tRT)と、骨髄温存型強度変調放射線療法(BMS-IMRT)を比較する治療計画研究を行った。
方法：10例の患者でCT-tRTとBMS-IMRTの治療計画を作成し、傍大動脈リンパ節に20Gyを照射するよう最適化した。CT-tRTは16MVの光子エネルギーを用いた前後-後前の対向平行二門照射、IMRTは6MVの光子エネルギーを用いた7方向の非対向同一平面照射とした。臨床標的体積(CTV)、計画標的体積(PTV)、臓器危険域(OAR)の線量体積ヒストグラムを、Wilcoxon符号付順位検定で両法について比較した。
結果：CTVおよびPTVの平均線量は両法で類似していた。ただし、PTVのD95%(19.7対19.5Gy、p=0.005)およびV95%(100対99.7%、p=0.011)では、CT-tRTがわずかに良好な標的被覆を示した。BMS-IMRTは活動性骨髄の平均線量を有意に5.2Gy低下させた(p=0.005)。OARのV100%およびV75%は、BMS-IMRTにより次の割合だけ低下した：活動性骨髄 V100% 51.7%、V75% 42.3%；腸 V100% 15.7%、V75% 16.8%；胃 V100% 22%、V75% 27.7%；膵臓 V100% 37.1%、V75% 35.9%(いずれもp=0.005)。
結論：BMS-IMRTは従来法と比べてOARへの線量を著明に低下させる。これにより、急性および長期の毒性、ならびに二次的な固形がんおよび血液がんのリスクを減らせると考えられる。
